flows.name: Authenticated admin CRUD request
flows.description: The shape every /api/admin/ endpoint follows: locale resolution, Sanctum token auth, FormRequest validation with ?with eager-loading, model write guarded by an observer, then an API resource response.

flows.name: Fight card generation
flows.description: POST tournaments/{tournament}/match_records/generate pairs unpaired registrations by discipline, weight, gender, age and experience tier, persists the bouts with contiguous sort order, and records unpairable registrations as matchmaking issues.

flows.name: Live match-record push
flows.description: Any edit to a bout (result, status, position) fires MatchRecordChanged after commit; the queued broadcast is picked up by Horizon and delivered over Reverb on the tournament's public channel.

flows.name: Public registration submission
flows.description: An athlete self-registers from the public form: lookup or creation by tax number, duplicate-guarded registration, a matchmaking-issues re-sync on the tournament, and finally the printable registration PDF.

flows.name: Public tournament board read
flows.description: Unauthenticated clients read in-progress and completed tournaments and their match records through a 60-second response cache, served by the reduced Public* resources.

flows.name: Two-step file upload and media attachment
flows.description: A file is uploaded ahead of the form, parked on the local temp disk with a cached descriptor, then attached to a model's media collection on save; whatever is never attached is pruned by the scheduled cleanup command.

flows.name: API-driven password reset
flows.description: auth/forgot_password sends a queued notification carrying a frontend reset URL; auth/reset_password then rewrites the password and revokes every existing token.
